title: El colectivo
goal: Understand that a taxi stopping for others is not a scam
culture: A colectivo picks up other passengers along the way and that is why it costs a third of what a private ride would. It is not your taxi and nothing has gone wrong. The only thing worth negotiating is the order of the drop-offs.

beats.good: Juntando means he is collecting passengers. ¿Va lleno? is really asking how many more he plans to fit, and the answer is always one more.

beats.es: Vamos cuatro. Pero usted va primero, no se preocupe.
beats.good: The order of the drop-offs is the entire negotiation in a colectivo, and it goes to whoever thinks to ask.

beats.es: Ahí voy a recoger a dos más, en la esquina nomás.
beats.good: It is not your taxi and the fare is a third of what it would be. No importa is both true and the right thing to say.

beats.es: Así es aquí, joven. Todos vamos llegando.
beats.en: That’s how it is here. That’s right.
beats.good: Así es aquí — that is how it is here. Said with a shrug, it explains a great deal of the country and excuses none of it.
